# Arnian Moving

> Bilingual (English/Spanish) cross-border moving company, part of Arnian Group. Moves households, vehicles and single items between California (and the rest of the U.S.) and Baja California / Baja California Sur, in both directions, including customs paperwork. Also does local moves in San Diego County. In business since 2013.

- Phone (calls): +52 (664) 388 6256
- WhatsApp: +52 (664) 385 0871
- Email: info@arnianmoving.com
- Offices: 9948 Via de la Amistad, San Diego, CA 92154, USA · C. Laguna Salada 4939, Lago Sur, Tijuana, BC 22217, Mexico
- Areas served in Baja: Tijuana, Rosarito, Ensenada, Tecate, Mexicali, San Felipe, San Quintín, Mulegé, Loreto, La Paz, Todos Santos, Los Barriles, Cerritos, San José del Cabo, Cabo San Lucas
